title: Employees
subtitle: Accounts, roles and teams
emptyText: Add your first employee so they can sign in.
emptyFiltered: No one found. Change the filters.
createDescription: A temporary password will be shown once after creation.
blocked: Employee blocked, all their sessions have been closed
blockConfirm: Block {name}? They will immediately lose access to the system.
resetConfirm: Reset the password for {name}? All of their sessions will be closed.
tempPasswordText: Give the password to {name} in person. It is shown only once — you won’t be able to see it after closing this window.
directionsHint: A project manager sees and runs all projects in the selected directions: e.g. “Media” — SMM, branding, production; websites (IT) are not visible to them.
deleteText: The employee will disappear from lists and won’t be able to sign in. Their history (payments, commissions, payroll, audit log) is kept. The email is freed up and can be given to a new employee.
transferHint: Open leads, deals, clients, projects, tasks, to-dos and Instagram conversations will be transferred to this employee
noOpenWork: No open work — the employee can be deleted.

specialtiesHint: You can pick several: when added to a project they become the member’s positions.
